references_supplied.section: Blé : analyses de sol, bilan azoté et références régionales
references_supplied.text:
L'élaboration de normes d'interprétation de la fertilité azotée des sols (N soil test Calibration) est basée sur les relations observées entre un indice de fertilité des sols (N Minéral, N-NO3-, N-NH4+, indice de disponibilité de l'azote) et la réponse de la plante. Dans ce qui suit, nous avons revu les travaux de recherche sur la fertilisation et nutrition azotées au Maroc afin de faire ressortir ces relations et références utiles en vue de l'élaboration de recommandations en matière de fertilisation azotée en Bour et en irrigué.

cases.answer:
### Observations
The uploaded RGB image shows a patchwork of agricultural fields with varying green and bare soil tones across multiple parcels. The user reports a synthetic scenario involving wheat in the central field in Doukkala, with unverified crop identity and soil conditions.

### Evidence and interpretations
Nitrogen deficiency in grasses can cause stunted growth, upright and stiffer light-green leaves, and defective tillering [MA_PNTTA_NPK_155, PDF p. 2](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_155.pdf#page=2). However, RGB imagery cannot establish crop identity, exact nutrient status, or soil conditions from appearance alone. Interpreting nitrogen fertility requires soil nitrogen testing, mineral nitrogen indices (such as N-NO3- and N-NH4+), or a nitrogen balance sheet approach [MA_PNTTA_WHEAT_N_62, PDF p. 1](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_62.pdf#page=1). In the irrigated perimeter of Doukkala, rational fertilizer use depends on soil type, initial nutrient richness, timing of application, and targeted yield levels [MA_PNTTA_DOUKKALA_70, PDF p. 1](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_70.pdf#page=1).

### Next checks
- Inspect the target parcel physically in the field to examine crop appearance and tillering.
- Collect soil or tissue samples for laboratory analysis to check nutrient availability.
- Review farm management, irrigation, and fertilization records.

L'image RGB montre une vue aérienne avec de multiples parcelles agricoles présentant des variations de coloration du vert au clair, sans qu'un ciblage précis ou une identité culturale ne puisse être confirmé par l'imagerie seule. En situation de carence azotée, les graminées peuvent présenter un tallage défectueux, des feuilles dressées devenant vert-clair, et un développement racinaire anormal [MA_PNTTA_NPK_155, PDF p. 2](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_155.pdf#page=2). Il convient de réaliser une inspection au champ pour observer l'état végétatif, de vérifier les données de sol et de recourir à des analyses de sol ou de tissu végétal. L'interprétation de la fertilisation azotée peut aussi s'appuyer sur des méthodes de bilan prévisionnel et des références régionales adaptées au blé en conditions irriguées ou en bour (1999, blé dur et blé tendre, Maroc) [MA_PNTTA_WHEAT_N_62, PDF p. 1](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_62.pdf#page=1).

cases.answer:
### Observations
The provided RGB image displays multiple agricultural parcels with varying crop covers and soil exposures across the top, center, bottom, left, and right. The user-reported field context is synthetic and unverified.

### Evidence and interpretations
In calcareous soils, soluble phosphorus ions can progressively become insoluble, primarily forming tricalcium phosphates and to a small extent apatite [MA_PNTTA_NPK_155, PDF p. 4](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_155.pdf#page=4). When soil analyses are available, calculating the phosphorus rate accounts for the soil's $P_2O_5$ richness, lime and organic matter content, as well as its clay content [MA_PNTTA_NPK_155, PDF p. 4](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_155.pdf#page=4).

### Next checks
Conduct a targeted parcel inspection and review local soil and tissue test results alongside irrigation and management records before adjusting any fertilizer practices.

### Evidence and interpretations
Dans les sols calcaires (2007, Maroc/général, synthèse de vulgarisation), les ions phosphore solubles s'insolubilisent très progressivement sous forme de phosphates tricalciques et d'apatite [MA_PNTTA_NPK_155, PDF p. 4](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_155.pdf#page=4). Le calcul de la dose de phosphore à partir des analyses de sol intègre la richesse du sol en P2O5, ainsi que sa teneur en calcaire, en matière organique et en argile [MA_PNTTA_NPK_155, PDF p. 4](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_155.pdf#page=4).

### Next checks
Il est recommandé de consulter les analyses de sol pour évaluer la richesse initiale et les teneurs en éléments pertinents, et de se référer aux services compétents ou aux outils régionaux adaptés (comme fertimap.ma) pour obtenir des conseils selon les contextes locaux [MA_PNTTA_NPK_155, PDF p. 4](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_155.pdf#page=4) [MA_INRA_LEGUMES, PDF p. 12](https://www.inra.org.ma/sites/default/files/publications/ouvrages/leguminkafacifr15.pdf#page=12). Effectuer des inspections sur place et vérifier les historiques d'irrigation et de gestion des parcelles.

cases.answer:
### Observations
The provided RGB image shows numerous agricultural parcels with varying greenness and bare soil patches, arranged in a grid-like pattern across the landscape. Multiple fields are visible, and the specific target parcel is ambiguous. The field context is explicitly synthetic, stating that the central field is irrigated while crop identity, soil tests, and irrigation records are unavailable. RGB imagery alone cannot establish NDVI, soil nutrient status, or crop identity.

### Evidence and interpretations
According to regional studies in the Bas-Service irrigated perimeter of Doukkala (2000, wheat and sugar beet), rational fertilizer use depends on the initial nutrient richness of the soil, soil type, application timing, and the target yield level [MA_PNTTA_DOUKKALA_70, PDF p. 1](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_70.pdf#page=1). Balanced mineral fertilization also helps improve the water use efficiency of irrigation [MA_PNTTA_DOUKKALA_70, PDF p. 1](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_70.pdf#page=1). Furthermore, national mapping studies in Morocco (2025, general cropland) note that phosphorus and potassium recommendations require crop-specific soil analysis, though open access to nutrient bioavailability data remains limited [MA_SOIL_MAPS_2025, PDF p. 1](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-025-05699-x.pdf#page=1). These sources provide background context for the Doukkala region [MA_PNTTA_DOUKKALA_70, PDF p. 1](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_70.pdf#page=1) [MA_SOIL_MAPS_2025, PDF p. 1](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-025-05699-x.pdf#page=1) [MA_PNTTA_DOUKKALA_70, PDF p. 1](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_70.pdf#page=1) but do not replace parcel-specific soil or water tests for the uploaded image.

### Next checks
- Inspect the target parcel in the field to evaluate crop condition and uniformity.
- Gather complete irrigation records and soil test data before changing fertilizer management [MA_PNTTA_DOUKKALA_70, PDF p. 1](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_70.pdf#page=1).
- Review management records and consult local agronomic guidance specific to the cultivated crop and soil type.

RGB imagery alone cannot establish crop identity, soil nutrient status, exact moisture levels, or the precise cause of heterogeneous crop growth. Document guidance for the irrigated perimeter of Doukkala (2000, wheat and sugar beet, Bas-Service irrigated perimeter of Doukkala; do not generalize to all Moroccan soils or to rainfed fields) indicates that rational fertilizer use depends on the soil's initial nutrient richness, the soil type, the timing of application, and the targeted yield level [MA_PNTTA_DOUKKALA_70, PDF p. 1](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_70.pdf#page=1). General Moroccan soil-management guidance (2002, general, Morocco; soil-sampling and laboratory workflow guidance) notes that fertilization must account for the plant, the soil, irrigation water, and the environment to optimize nutrition and prevent toxicities or deficiencies [MA_PNTTA_SOIL_ANALYSIS_93, PDF p. 1](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_93.pdf#page=1).

### Next checks
- Inspect the target parcel directly in the field to assess crop development and heterogeneity.
- Collect soil and plant tissue data alongside irrigation and management records [MA_PNTTA_DOUKKALA_70, PDF p. 1](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_70.pdf#page=1) [MA_PNTTA_SOIL_ANALYSIS_93, PDF p. 1](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_93.pdf#page=1).
- Verify local soil fertility and irrigation water quality before adjusting any management practices.

references_supplied.text:
L'élaboration de normes d'interprétation de la fertilité azotée des sols (N soil test Calibration) est basée sur les relations observées entre un indice de fertilité des sols (N Minéral, N-NO3-, N-NH4+, indice de disponibilité de l'azote) et la réponse de la plante. cases.answer:
### Observations
The uploaded image is an RGB satellite view showing multiple agricultural fields with varying green and bare soil tones. The user reports a synthetic demo context where the central parcel is wheat with lighter patches, but an ambiguous target parcel requires careful verification.

### Evidence and interpretations
RGB appearance alone cannot establish nitrogen status, soil nutrient levels, or specific crop deficiencies. Nitrogen deficiency symptoms in cereals, as described in a Moroccan extension synthesis (2007, general crops, Moroccan extension synthesis with some examples from other regions, including France), can include stunted, upright, light-green leaves and defective tillering [MA_PNTTA_NPK_155, PDF p. 2](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_155.pdf#page=2). However, establishing soil nitrogen fertility or diagnosing deficiencies requires proper calibration and analytical methods rather than visual inspection alone. For Moroccan wheat (1999, durum wheat, bread wheat, Moroccan wheat, including bour favorable and irrigated systems; includes Gharb-related research), soil nitrogen test calibration (such as mineral nitrogen or nitrate/ammonium indices) or a predictive nitrogen balance method taking into account crop needs and soil supply are utilized [MA_PNTTA_WHEAT_N_62, PDF p. 1](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_62.pdf#page=1). Fertilizer use efficiency also depends on soil type, previous crops, climatic conditions, and whether the system is rainfed (bour) or irrigated (2014, durum wheat, bread wheat, barley, Morocco; distinguish bour (rainfed) from irrigated systems) [MA_INRA_CEREALS, PDF p. 14](https://www.inra.org.ma/sites/default/files/publications/ouvrages/guideorgefr.pdf#page=14).

### Next checks
Perform a targeted parcel inspection to verify crop health and identify the exact target parcel. Collect soil and tissue samples for laboratory analysis to evaluate nitrogen availability. Review local irrigation and management records, and consult regional soil testing and nitrogen balance guidelines for wheat [MA_PNTTA_WHEAT_N_62, PDF p. 1](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_62.pdf#page=1) [MA_INRA_CEREALS, PDF p. 14](https://www.inra.org.ma/sites/default/files/publications/ouvrages/guideorgefr.pdf#page=14).
